units.does: no behavioural claim: trigger and goal (24-48 h).

units.does: no behavioural claim: branch from main and merge back by PR.

units.key: § Runbook: Hotfix Deployment > 3. Land the smallest possible change
units.does: no behavioural claim: smallest change plus regression test.

units.key: § Runbook: Hotfix Deployment > 4. Run the verification checklist
units.does: Claims make ci must pass (lint, budget, infoplist-guard, sendable-guard, test-coverage, with values in .ci/*.txt), the budget gate fails on new .shared or ObservableObject, Release build command, cold-start os_signpost 'init.*' events in EmuquApp.swift. Verified: Makefile:272 ci target includes these; EmuquApp.swift:129-159 emits init.collector, init.cloudKitSyncManager etc. via signpostStart/End.
calls: .github/workflows/ci.yml::step lint-and-budgets/Singletons read only in the composition root

units.does: Claims MARKETING_VERSION is bumped manually in every configuration; CI build number is run_number.run_attempt passed as CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION; agvtool unusable because VERSIONING_SYSTEM is not set. Verified: testflight.yml:150-159; project.pbxproj has 0 VERSIONING_SYSTEM lines.

units.key: § Runbook: Hotfix Deployment > Hard "do not" list
units.does: Claims the pre-commit hook is a SwiftLint gate that does not run make ci and can be bypassed with --no-verify. .githooks/pre-commit exists (installed by scripts/install-git-hooks.sh / make setup-hooks) and documents --no-verify as the emergency bypass.
